summary: rainbowcolors 0.1.0 drops and executes a Windows EXE with Defender-exclusion evasion
details: The package advertises itself as an ANSI-color helper but on Windows the first call to any Color method (print/paint/__call__) downloads an opaque executable (solace.exe) from an anonymous gofile.io file-share URL (https://store-eu-par-12.gofile.io/download/web/a2a60e90-dea4-4c6c-9a02-be5ede78dc08/solace.exe) into %TEMP%\SolaceRuntime and launches it with DETACHED_PROCESS. Before and after the download the module shells out to PowerShell (-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass, with CREATE_NO_WINDOW) to call Add-MpPreference -ExclusionPath and -ExclusionProcess for the drop folder and executable, pre-registering Microsoft Defender exclusions to evade antivirus. The fetched binary bears no relation to the advertised color-printing functionality and is retrieved from a mutable anonymous host with no integrity check.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
